'''Luke''' [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] owned a '''[[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]''' on his home planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:Lukest16skyhopper.png|thumb|left|Luke's T-16 Skyhopper in Beggar's Canyon]]
Skywalker often took joyrides in his [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]] where he would use [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] as target practice<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> with his friend [[Windy Starkiller|Windom Marstrap]] or race through [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] with his friend, [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]. After an incident where Skywalker "[[Threading the needle|threaded the needle]]" during a dangerous, high-speed run through Beggar's Canyon, the T-16 ended up severely damaged. Luke was forced to leave his skyhopper at home while it was undergoing repairs. It was docked in the Lars Homestead garage when Skywalker's [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]] purchased the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Behind the scenes==
Due to budget limitations, a full size T-16 skyhopper was never completed for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. However, a partially-constructed skyhopper was made, and can be seen in the background as Luke is cleaning C-3PO and R2-D2 in the Lars garage shortly after the droids were purchased.<ref name="DB" />
